extension.name: Linear Weave
extension.description: Weave Spec Kit into Linear: pull requirements, mirror tasks.md into sub-issues, sync statuses.
extension.author: Tony Woodhouse

commands.name: speckit.linear-weave.pull
commands.description: Pull requirements from a referenced Linear issue before writing the spec

commands.name: speckit.linear-weave.link
commands.description: Record the feature's Linear issue reference in spec.md and post the spec summary to Linear

commands.name: speckit.linear-weave.tasks
commands.description: Update the feature's Linear issue from tasks.md and create sub-issues at the configured granularity (task / phase / story)

commands.name: speckit.linear-weave.sync
commands.description: Reconcile Linear issue statuses with task completion state in tasks.md

commands.name: speckit.linear-weave.flow
commands.description: Guided one-chat orchestration of specify -> clarify -> plan -> tasks for a Linear issue, pausing at each review gate (user-invocable; not a hook)

hooks.description: Pull requirements from a referenced Linear issue
Link the feature directory to its Linear issue
Create Linear sub-issues for generated tasks
Move Linear issues to In Progress and arm per-task status sync
Reconcile Linear statuses with completed tasks

config.name: linear-config.yml
config.description: Sub-issue granularity, workflow status mapping, and comment toggles
